primary_method_scopes.incremental_claim_consequence: Efficient shared/global plus private/local factor meta-learning is explicit recent ancestry. Local resetting and test adaptation materially differ from the active persistent serving operator.

roles.commit: After each task, local A/B mean and variance factors are assigned from the global factors. No candidate-style carried private row and recomputed inner-only commit at new shared weights is specified.
roles.optimizer_state: AppendixA.3 says all methods use AdamW and five inner steps. Algorithm1 does not specify exact Adam moments, their reset/carry convention, epsilon/weight-decay response derivative, or current-gradient/old-moment detach semantics. No native-Adam equivalence claimed.
roles.outer_credit: Algorithm1 states inner gradient descent in local phi and outer gradient descent in global theta for expected likelihood plus KL terms. Exact differentiation through the optimizer update, rather than direct prior/posterior dependence, is not explicit in the selected algorithm; author code not read.
roles.query_graph: Language-model task datasets Di, not graph link queries. Algorithm1 draws inner Di batches and uses Di notation in the outer objective; a separately endpoint-excluded outer query set is not specified.
roles.serving: Algorithm1 makes a copy for an unseen task, performs local likelihood adaptation, evaluates remaining data, deletes the copy and reloads original weights. No adaptation-free persistent four-member mean-raw-logit serving is specified.
roles.shared: Pretrained W0 plus global LoRA mean/log-variance factors; task-local posterior factors are the fast variables. Four factor pairs are global/local mean/variance roles, not four ensemble members.

primary_method_scopes.version_boundary: v1 used sigma factorization and separate beta/gamma coefficients; v3 writes log-variance factorization, one beta and an explicit algorithm. Version equivalence is not assumed.

primary_method_scopes.incremental_claim_consequence: A shared graph encoder, task-specific predictors and gradient-free test algorithm are recent component ancestry. The primary algorithm narrows the abstract ensemble/no-tuning language; it does not establish adaptation-free fixed-committee graph serving.

roles.commit: Learned training-domain representations z are stored after training. Algorithms do not retain four private learner/Adam trajectories or recompute a private optimizer step from old weights/moments after a slow commit.
roles.optimizer_state: Implementation subsection names Adam. Training Algorithm1 updates learnable parameters by one backpropagation of query/variational loss. Separate persistent domain optimizer states and an unfolded inner Adam response are not specified.
roles.outer_credit: Query supervised MSE and variational term train encoder/attention/parameter generator through generated Phi_t. The fast map is support-conditioned amortized generation, not a private optimizer learning step.
roles.query_graph: Chronological domains, each split into support/query time-series samples; Eq3-4 use sensor adjacency A for diffusion. This is forecasting on a spatial graph, not positive/negative link prediction or endpoint-union exclusion.
roles.serving: Algorithm2 partitions unseen-domain data into support/query, samples its latent representation, attends to stored training representations, generates one predictor and evaluates query. No gradient update is listed. The method is support-conditioned parameter generation, not a prescribed raw-logit mean of persistent output models.
roles.shared: Shared diffusion-convolutional GRU encoder for sensor spatial adjacency, Gaussian domain representations, cross-domain attention and decoder F generating two-layer MLP predictor parameters Phi_t.
